repo: Callisto uses git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ (e.g. wp-g-pre-v3, wp-h-managed-prerelease) for parallel workstreams.
Changesets live in .changeset and are committed together with crates and docs; status --since <ref> assigns each changed file to the package whose directory most closely contains it.
Test, mutation, and gate scripts are wrapped in helper scripts under /Users/gabe/.claude/jobs/b38d2eaf/tmp/ (c.sh wrapping cargo commands, mutants.sh taking a crate and a list of files).
Test suites run with cargo nextest run --workspace --no-fail-fast.

workflow: Run mutation testing against the workstream's own base (MUTANTS_BASE=<local merge commit>) so mutants from upstream workstreams (F1/F2) are not re-tested.
Run independent suites and reviewers in parallel, then wait on all of them together.
Use fresh reviewer agents per diff for independent review.
